title: Remove network coordinator worker tab switch
summary: Remove the Network page's manual Coordinator/Worker sub-tabs and render the role dashboard directly from the saved distributed-mode role.
reason: The Coordinator and Worker tabs duplicated role context and let standalone/coordinator modes show the wrong dashboard, making the Network page appear inconsistent with the saved role.
behavior_before: The Network page always showed a Coordinator/Worker tab strip and persisted a local tab choice that could disagree with the saved role.
behavior_after: The Network page has no role tab strip; standalone mode falls through to the mode summary, worker mode shows worker evidence, coordinator mode shows coordinator evidence, and coordinator-local mode shows both relevant dashboards.
